comments.author: @RealLifeFilesDoc
comments.text: The journalistic integrity of this script is phenomenal. It's rare for travel documentaries to actually address the harsh realities behind the high quality of life. Breaking down the fact that Belgium has the highest labor tax burden in the OECD (taking nearly 52.5% of a single worker's income) [23:27], and exposing how the strict language requirements create a massive barrier for non-EU immigrants [25:41], adds so much necessary depth. You proved that high taxes buy a great safety net, but it's not a utopia. Exceptional research! 👏
